# Example 10—Readable and Writable External Tables with XML Transformations

WarehousePG can read and write XML data to and from external tables with gpfdist. For information about setting up an XML transform, see [Transforming External Data with gpfdist and gpload](https://www.enterprisedb.com/docs/warehousepg/6/admin_guide/load/transforming-xml-data/).

**Parent topic:** [Examples for Creating External Tables](https://www.enterprisedb.com/docs/warehousepg/6/admin_guide/external/external-tables/creating-external-tables---examples/)
